item.name: STUDIO PORTAL
item.label: Agency platform
item.description: Studio Portal connects internal teams, clients, projects, deliverables and living brand systems in one controlled experience. The studio workspace runs the work (role-based homes, tasks, review lifecycle), while an explicit publish boundary decides what clients see in their simplified portal, including approvals and a published Brand Hub.

blocks.caption: CLIENT PORTAL — ONLY WHAT NEEDS YOU.
BRAND HUB — ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
